definitions.explanation: Having a set time limit. Used in employment and law, as in {有期|ゆうき}{雇用|こよう} (fixed-term employment), and the opposite of {無期|むき} (indefinite).

examples.japanese: {有期|ゆうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}ぶ→契約を結ぶ：18695_keiyakuwomusubu⟧。
{有期|ゆうき}{雇用|こよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of fixed-term employees is rising.

examples.japanese: {有期|ゆうき}{契約|けいやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通算|つうさん}→通算：18159_tsuusan⟧{五年|ごねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{無期|むき}⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{転換|てんかん}→転換：19439_tenkan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}める→申し込む：02311_moushikomu⟧。
examples.english: Once fixed-term contracts add up to more than five years, the worker can apply to switch to an open-ended contract.

notes:
{有|ゆう} (having) + {期|き} (term); the opposite is {無期|むき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有期|ゆうき}{雇用|こよう}: fixed-term employment
- {有期|ゆうき}{契約|けいやく}: fixed-term contract
- {有期刑|ゆうきけい}: a prison sentence of fixed length

CULTURAL NOTE:
News reports long used {有期|ゆうき}⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧ (fixed-term imprisonment with labor). Since the 2025 penal reform merged ⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧ and ⟦{禁錮|きんこ}→禁錮：19211_kinko⟧ into a single sentence, ⟦{拘禁刑|こうきんけい}→拘禁刑：31846_koukinkei⟧, the term is {有期|ゆうき}⟦{拘禁刑|こうきんけい}→拘禁刑：31846_koukinkei⟧.

WATCH OUT:
⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧ (courage) and ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧ (organic) are read the same; {有期|ゆうき} appears only in contract, employment and legal language.
